thread:
Priya Patel: customer reported rerank returning almost-constant scores after they upgraded their retrieval embeddings to open-embed-xlarge. they say ordering is wrong even though the embeddings looked "normal" in their pipeline. attaching sanitized request and short logs.

Maya Chen: can you paste the exact request body (sanitized) and the rerank response?

Priya Patel: sanitized payload below — they send 5 candidates, embed dims are 2048 in the payload.
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  `reranker_model`: `redwood-reranker-v1`,
  `query_embedding_dim`: 2048,
  `candidate_embedding_dims`: 2048,
  `candidate_embeddings`: [[...2048 floats...], [...2048 floats...], [...]],
}
```
Response (200): scores: [0.995, 0.994, 0.994, 0.993, 0.993] — too close, different docs.

Jin Park: hmm. what does the rerank node log show for dims? historically some reranker models expect 1536 or 1024. if we coerce/clip silently it can make vectors similar.

Priya Patel: log snippet (rerank) for request-id req-88b:
```
[rerank-service] recv candidates=5 dims=2048
[rerank-service] model_signature: redwood-reranker-v1 expects dims=1536
[rerank-service] fallback: downsample_to=1536 (no client warning) -> scoring
```

Omar Ruiz: ok that confirms silent downsample. that produces compressed representations and artificially high cos sims. customer is right. immediate remediation ideas: 1) reject mismatched dims with 400 and clear message, 2) add a compatibility mapper to suggest which embed models to use, 3) telemetry alert for silent conversions.

Maya Chen: for customer-facing quick fix, advise them to pin retrieval model to open-embed-large (1536) which is what their previous pipeline used. can we provide a small check they can run?

Jin Park: opened PR to enforce validation + better error. change will return 400 with this body: 
```
{"error":"embedding_dim_mismatch", "message":"incoming embeddings dimension 2048 does not match reranker expected 1536. Use a compatible embed model or run a conversion. See /docs/embed-rerank-compat."}
```
PR: #2491

infra-bot: deploy plan: staging -> canary -> prod, canary scheduled in 18 hours if tests pass.

Omar Ruiz: I'll add an admin endpoint so support can query model expected dims and the canonical embed pairing:
```
GET /admin/model-pairs?model=redwood-reranker-v1
# returns ["open-embed-large (1536)", "open-embed-base (1536)"]
```

Priya Patel: I shared the temporary curl and mapping with the customer. they rolled back to the embedded model combo we recommended and confirmed rerank ordering returned to expected distribution.

Jin Park: long term we should: 1) strict validation at edge, 2) compatibility mapping for allowed pairings, 3) opt-in conversion only with an explicit flag (e.g., `compatibility_mode`) so customers are aware of lossy transforms. I'll add a telemetry rule to alert when the service sees >5% of rerank calls where incoming_dim != expected_dim.

Priya Patel: created support ticket #12890 to track customer impact and follow-up. linking PR #2491. leaving the thread open until canary completes.

support-bot: ticket #12890 created and linked to PR #2491

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. once canary is green i'll notify the customer and close the ticket.
